sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. The visitors sit bottom of the table with just 4 points and have lost five of their last six matches, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to return to winning ways. Sandbach then travel away to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October in their second fixture of the week; the Nomads are struggling in 17th place with seven points from ten games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host bottom-of-the-table Widnes Town on Saturday 3 October—the Stafford side also suffered a recent loss and will be keen to close the gap on Sandbach at the summit. Widnes are winless across their last five matches and remain in a parlous position with just 2 points. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third with 19 points, travel to face Eccleshall (6th, 18 points) on the same day in an intriguing mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points and in strong form with three consecutive wins, host Wednesfield Community on Saturday 3 October; the away side are mid-table but have also shown recent improvement. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) are in-form visitors to Foley Meir (13th, 11 points) on Saturday 3. Fellow strugglers Brereton Social (14th, 11 points) host Widnes Town on Saturday 3—a fixture between two teams in poor form—then host Wednesfield Community in a midweek encounter on Wednesday 7 October. The second round of fixtures on Saturday 10 October sees Allscott Heath (11th) hosting leaders Sandbach (covered above), Alsager Town welcoming mid-table Shawbury United, Barnton receiving Dawley Town, Bilston Town hosting Crewe, Market Drayton Town playing Widnes Town, Telford Town visiting New Mills, and Stafford Town at home to Wednesfield Community. Several of these fixtures pit struggling sides against one another, with New Mills (8th, 14 points) hosting Telford Town (18th, 6 points) offering a clearer gulf in form.
